title: Let's meet for the first time
description:
Spoznavno srečanje R-Ladies Ljubljana v Cacaotu BTC :)

Pridi, spij kavico/čajček in spoznaj uporabnike R s celotne Slovenije.

Popolnoma brez obveznosti!

title: Delavnica: PONOVLJIVA ZNANOST? (reproducible research)
description:
Na tokratni delavnici bomo poskusili:
\- potegnili kodo iz githuba\,
\- ponovili analizo \(narisali graf ali dva\)
\- primerjali rezultate med seboj\!

Vabljeni vsi, ki vas zanimajo orodja za ponovljivo znanost in R!

On this workshop we will :
\- pull code and data from github
\- reproduce 1 or 2 figures made with the data and code
\- compare results\!

Welcome all who are interested!

Geslo ZOOM: RLadies

title: DELAVNICA: Mešano
description:
KONČNO organiziramo novo delavnico!

Dobimo v četrtek 26. oktobra ob 18:00 na Litostrojska 52a (industrijska cona Šiška) - podjetje Sportradar.

Trenutno imamo pripravljeni dve zelo različni predstavitvi:
\- prikaz prostorskih podatkov in
\- nadaljevanje uporabe Git \(in GitHub\)
\- sekvenciranje in obdelava človeškega genoma\.

Absolutno pa se dobimo za reševanje vseh zagat in zadreg v katerih se znajdete, tako da kar na plano z vprašanji!

Zoom opcija: geslo je RLadies

title: DELAVNICA: Organizacija projekta v R
description:
Vabljeni na 1. delavnico z naslovom: ORGANIZACIJA PROJEKTA V R

V sredo 25. 1. 2023 v na Oddelku za biologijo, Večna pot 111, 1000 Ljubljana v predavalnici B1.

Parkiranje: Na makedamskem parkingu nasproti ZOO Ljubljana.

title: ggplot2_v2
description:
Na tokratni delavnici bomo raziskovali, kako smiselno in učinkovito predstaviti podatke z uporabo paketa ggplot2 v R verzija 2.
Na delavnici bomo set podatkov v parih/trojicah poskušali čim bolj smiselno predstavit. Prvi bo pisal, drugi pa narekal in potem obratno! Učili se bomo drug od drugega skozi pisanje kode.
\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-
In this workshop, we will explore how to meaningfully and effectively present data using the ggplot2 package in R. One person will dictate another write the code, and then we switch. We will learn from each other through code writing.

**The workshop will take place exclusively in person!**

title: HOW TO: present results
description:
Na tokratni delavnici bomo raziskovali, kako smiselno in učinkovito predstaviti podatke z uporabo paketa ggplot2 v R. Vabljeni, da prinesete tudi svoje rezultate, za katere niste prepričani, kako jih uspešno vizualizirati.
Poleg tega bomo spoznali paket SRAdb, ki omogoča neposreden prenos podatkov iz podatkovne baze SRA v okolje R.

**Delavnica bo potekala izključno v živo!**
\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-
In this workshop, we will explore how to meaningfully and effectively present data using the ggplot2 package in R. We encourage you to bring your own results, especially if you're unsure how to visualize them successfully.
Additionally, we will introduce the SRAdv package, which allows direct retrieval of data from the SRA database into the R environment.

**The workshop will take place exclusively in person!**

title: So-uporaba R in Python v RStudio
description:
Naslov name pove vse. Žan nam bo pokazal kako lahko so-uporabljamo R in Python v RStudiu, v eni sami kodi.

Tokrat se ponovno vidimo v čudovitih prostorih Sportradar-ja na Litostrojski 52a!

The title says it all. We will try and see how to use R and Python in the same code (different chunks) in RStudio.

title: WE KEEP THE SOCIAL PART!
description:
UNFORTUNATELY THE EVENT'S LECTURE IS CANCELED, BUT THE SOCIAL PART REMAINS! (read pizza and hang in Maribor's city center).

The meeting will be held at the **Medical Faculty of the University of Maribor (lecture room 2N2)**. Parking is available either in the Europark shopping centre (free) or on the street in front of the Faculty (1€/h).
***For the first time ever the R-Ladies event will come to Maribor!***

***We'll host:***
***[William R. Shoemaker](https://wrshoemaker.github.io/),*** *who studies the ecological and evolutionary dynamics of microbial communities by coupling experimental and observational data with intuitive mathematical models containing few, if any, free parameters. He is currently a fellow in the **Quantitative Ecology and Evolution Group** at **The Abdus Salam Centre for Theoretical Physics (ICTP)**.*
*\*\* Because the speaker is English-speaking, this event will be held in English. \*\**

title: Shotgun metaganomic data: what to do with it?
description:
V torek 1. aprila (ni šala) se spet dobimo na @Genialis-u, kjer nam bo Marko predstavil raziskave mikrobiote s shotgun metagenomskimi podatki. Predstavil bo obdelavo podatkov od sekvenc dalje, torej čiščenje, orodja, zanke in cake!

Lepo vabljeni!

title: Paralelizacija v R & ROCKER
description:
Novo leto je tu in prav tako delavnice R-Ladies!

Tokrat nam bo Jernej pokazal, kako lahko tudi **v R paraleliziramo** svoje naloge in malce se bomo spoznali z zanimivim singularity imageom: **ROCKER**, ki omogoča uporabo RStudia na HPC sistemih.

Lepo vabljeni, na sedaj že znano lokacijo @Genialis.
